build_encoder_decoder_model: build a FairseqEncoderDecoderModel by passing an encoder and decoder instance to the constructor
load_pretrained_model: load a pretrained fairseq model using BaseFairseqModel.from_pretrained with a model name or path
optimize_generation_speed: optimize a fairseq model for faster generation by calling make_generation_fast_ to remove weight norms
extract_features_decoder_only: extract features from a FairseqLanguageModel by calling extract_features with source tokens
combine_multi_model: combine multiple encoder-decoder models into a FairseqMultiModel using dictionaries of encoders and decoders
